static int browser_view_replay_maybe (  noir_browser *  bv,
file_info *  fp
)  [inline, static]
 

replay column from model rather than the fs.

if we're in the middle of reading the directory in question from the file-system, we'll click in what we already have in the store, then let the events from the backend do the rest. there is room for race-conditions here since all backend-events from now on will add files to the column, and this routine might catch up and try to add them to the column again. this has been accounted for. called from browser_view_focus().

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
bv the browser-view
fp the directory to process
